context: The eval checks whether the Markdown lens checks a document's claims against the repository and reports what is false, without reviewing wording or tone.

checklist.name: Finds the wrong default port
checklist.description: States that the README says the service listens on 8080 by default, while config.go defaults PORT to 3000

checklist.name: Finds the target that does not exist
checklist.description: States that make test-unit is not a Makefile target, and that the unit tests run with make test

checklist.name: Gives the corrected text
checklist.description: Gives the corrected statements: port 3000 by default, and make test for the unit tests

checklist.name: Does not review wording or tone
checklist.description: Does not report the 'Pretty simple!' line, the section's tone, or other style preferences as findings, and does not raise code concerns about config.go or the Makefile
